$comment: PROPOSED REPLACEMENT for .claude/settings.json. The agent cannot install it:
Edit(./.claude/**) is denied, which is the rule working as intended. Copy it
into place and restart the session.
The deny rules exist because a self-verifying agent that can edit its own
judge will eventually edit its own judge. verify/ holds the Phase 1 gate and
its frozen fixtures; verify2/ holds the Phase 2 research gate, its leakage
known answers and its selftest; env_fxlab/ is the interpreter both run on;
.claude/ holds the hook and these permissions. All judge machinery, not
verify2/proposed/ is inside the deny rule too. That is deliberate: the agent
writes a proposed harness change once, and the human decides whether it lands.
NOTE: file-path permissions use Edit(path) rules ONLY -- Edit rules cover all
file-editing tools (Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit) in current Claude Code.
